ns2:section.sectionText: This class will meet October 1-2, October 29-30 and December 3-4, 2010. Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for the EOL Oak Brook CCEL (Higher Ed) Doctoral cohort that began in 2007. This class will be offered in Oak Brook at a location to be announced at a later date. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $502.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
